BACHELOR OF ENGINEERING (AEROSPACE ENGINEERING)

1st & 2nd Semester

1st SEMESTER
Common to Aerospace, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Industrial, and Mechanical Engineering Programs
REQUIRED:

Introduction to Engineering
* Writing Skills
General Chemistry
Calculus I
Linear Algebra

Physics: Mechanics

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

* This course is graded on a pass/fail basis.

2nd SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Engineering Design and Graphical Comm
Digital Computation and Programming
Principles of Engineering Economics
Calculus II
Materials Science Fundamentals
Physics: Waves and Fields

3rd & 4th Semester

Revised curriculum commencing Fall 2013 - Winter 2014.

3rd SEMESTER

REQUIRED:

Basic Thermodynamics
Fluid Mechanics
Dynamics
Statics and Intro to Strength of Materials
Communication in the Engineering Professions
Differential Equations and Vector Calculus

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 3rd semester.

4th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:

Mechanisms and Vibrations
Intro. to Aerospace Engineering Design
Flight Mechanics
Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer
Electric Circuits
Statistics
NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 4th semester.

5th & 6th Semester

5th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:

Aerodynamics
Materials and Manufacturing
Stress Analysis
Electric Machines and Electronics
Numerical Analysis

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 5th semester.

6th SEMESTER

Revised curriculum commencing Winter 2014 for students admitted in Fall 2011 and after.

REQUIRED:

Control Systems
Component Design and Material Selection
Aircraft Performance
Aerospace Structural Design
Gas Dynamics

PROFESSIONAL: One course from the following. Students must complete the requirements for one of the following Streams:

Aircraft Stream
AER 626 Applied Finite Elements

Avionics Stream
EES 604 Electronics and Sensors

Spacecraft Stream
AER 627 Introduction to Space Robotics

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 6th semester.
NOTE: Students who have a CLEAR Academic Standing after 6th semester may opt to enroll in the Industrial Internship (IIP) . Students will be enrolled in WKT 89A/B by the Department.

7th & 8th Semester

Semesters 7 and 8 of the Aircraft Option, Avionics Option and Spacecraft Option are last offered in 2013-2014.

Semesters 7 and 8 of the Aircraft Stream, Avionics Stream and Spacecraft Stream are first offered 2014-2015.

7th SEMESTER

Revised curriculum commencing Fall 2013 for students admitted Fall 2010 and after.

REQUIRED:

Avionics and Systems
Systems Engineering

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from the following:
Science Fiction
Technology and the Contemporary Environment
Scientific Technology and Modern Society
Religion, Science and Philosophy
Power, Change and Technology

PROFESSIONAL: Two courses from the following. Students must complete the requirements for the Option/Stream chosen in 6th semester.

Aircraft Option/Stream:
Aircraft Stability and Control
Aeroelasticity

Avionics Option/Stream:
Digital Systems
Aircraft Stability and Control
Spacecraft Option/Stream:
Orbital Dynamics
Introduction to Space Systems Design
NOTE: All required courses in 1st through 4th semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 7th semester.

8th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:

Propulsion
Law and Ethics in Engineering Practice

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table B .

PROFESSIONAL: One course from the following:

Manufacturing Management
Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics and Control
* Aerospace Engineering Thesis
PROFESSIONAL: One from the following Options/Streams. Students must complete the requirements of the Option/Stream chosen previously.
Aircraft Option/Stream:
Aircraft Design Project
Avionics Option/Stream:
Avionics Design Project
Spacecraft Option/Stream:
Space Systems Design Project

* Effective 2014-2015, students wishing to enroll in AER 870 must have a CGPA of at least 3.00 and must seek Departmental Consent.
 Not every course will be offered every semester.

NOTE: All required courses in 1st through 4th semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 8th semester.
